Summoners War: Chronicles opens limited sign-ups


Developer Com2uS has just opened limited pre-registrations for Summoners War: Chronicles, its upcoming MMORPG for smartphones. By limited, what they really mean is that you can only sign up if you are in Thailand.  Of course, if you really wanted to, there are ways to circumvent that restriction to try the game out.   Related Posts   Pokemon Sleep Now Available In Malaysia   GamerBraves Newsletter Vol. 103 – The Glory of The Barbie/Oppenheimer Double Feature   A detailed description of what to expect from Summoners War: Chronicles as follows:
A New World for Adventurous Summoners
Summoners War: Chronicles is a brand new MMORPG and a pivotal addition to the universe of Summoners War. Players will find themselves in a time before both Sky Arena and Lost Centuria, where they get to choose one of three Summoners, each equipped with unique skills and different appearances. As they go on their adventures, the Summoners’ team will consist of up to three monsters. The distinct battle skills they possess can lead to a variety of different experiences.

Familiar Monsters in a Colorful Open World
As they venture through sheer endless continents, players will encounter grasslands, deserts, elven forests, glaciers, volcanos, and more immersive surroundings with unique attributes. But they need to be careful: Once players enter the Region Dungeons, they will be facing side quests such as traps and puzzles, before this they must collect their remaining strength to face off against powerful bosses.
In Summoners War: Chronicles, players will meet various known monsters from Sky Arena, and creatures that are new to the world of Summoners War. Their monster decks can be formed strategically, since the skills and appearances of each monster will depend on their attributes.
Combining Forces
Players of Summoners War: Chronicles will be able to bring together friends or other Summoners they encounter along their way for cooperative gameplay. In Raids, players will form a party to attack a boss and collect rare rewards, while in Field Boss they must defeat a boss alongside many other Summoners to collect rewards based on the contribution they made.
Player vs Player
Naturally, Summoners War: Chronicles will offer a wide choice of PvP challenges: Arena, Real-Time Arena, and 2vs2 Real-Time Arena, where players will compete against other Summoners and utilize their individual monster decks to carry off the victory.
For more information on the game, be sure to drop by the official website. And if you are from Thailand, sign up from its store page.

reference_summary: Com2uS telah membuka prapendaftaran terhad untuk MMORPG akan datang, Summoners War: Chronicles, tetapi hanya untuk mereka yang berada di Thailand. Permainan ini menampilkan dunia baharu untuk penyeru yang mencabar, dengan raksasa yang dikenali dari Sky Arena dan yang baharu untuk ditemui. Pemain boleh memilih salah satu daripada tiga pemanggil, masing-masing dengan kemahiran dan penampilan yang unik, dan membentuk satu pasukan sehingga tiga raksasa untuk pertempuran. Permainan ini menampilkan dunia terbuka yang berwarna-warni dengan pelbagai persekitaran yang mengasyikkan, serta pilihan permainan yang bekerjasama seperti Raids dan Field Boss. Cabaran PvP juga tersedia, termasuk Arena, Arena Masa Nyata dan Arena Masa Nyata 2vs2. Untuk maklumat lanjut, layari laman web rasmi.
